I reviewed the diff and wrote `review.md`; the verdict is `pass`, with five notes and no required fixes. I checked only the code and docs in `diff.patch`. I did not run the test or the backfill.

- **Not checkable:** the diff doesn't include the generated `asks.jsonl` files, the per-module pages, `asks-by-module.md`, the card or the landing line. I couldn't verify the counts or the card title.
- **File name differs from the brief:** the module pages are written as `doc/refined-asks.md`, not `doc/asks.md`. The Refine doc explains why: four modules already hold a hand-merged `asks.md`.
- **"Done" is narrower than asked:** the brief also counted a landing line whose title matches. The code only uses AskTally's judged features, so just 19 of 1061 backfilled asks come out done.
- **Error handling:** the new call in `Server/RefineQueue.mjs` (line 171) isn't in a try/catch. An inbox or file error there would fail a refine run after its card was already added.
- **Test scope:** `Server/AskIndex.test.mjs` covers record, cross-off, inbox-once and no duplicates on a re-run, but on a throwaway repo. The brief named `ux/Dictate` with today's asks.
